conbody.p: Use the following checks for common gateway and API issues.

ul.li: Confirm that the API credential is valid.
Review the event log for the failure reason.

section.title: API returns 401 Unauthorized
section.p: Verify that the API key is active and sent in the Authorization header.

section.title: API returns 429 Too Many Requests
section.p: Reduce request frequency and use exponential backoff. Check configured rate limits before retrying.
